hero.caption:
Sunset in Oia, Santorini.
Here is my version of the sunset shot in Oia. This is a blend of 3 shots, 1.3 to 20 seconds, processed as follows:
1) Reduce noice on all 3 raws.
2) Create HRD in Photomatix
3) Blend using Exposure Fusion, sliders set to produce the most natural looking image while still showing some detail in the very dark areas.
4) PS smart sharpen.
5) PS burn the bottom
6) Nik Brilliance and warming
7) Nik Indian summer to warm th elights, masked to not affect the rest.
8) Nik sunlight, brushed over the buildings to add more light
9) Nik Glamour Glow to remove detail in the dark areas.
10) Detailed curves lightening pn windmills.

11) Dodge buildings that were too dark.

images.filename: Resurrection of the Lord Holy Orthodox Church in Οία.jpg
images.caption: The picture shows the Greek Orthodox Churches "Anastasi Church" and "Agios Spyridon Church". The Anastasi Church (right) was built in 1865 and is dedicated to the Resurrection of Jesus Christ. In front of it, the Agios Spyridon Church, built in 1867, with its accompanying blue bell tower. Both churches are built in the traditional style of Cycladic architecture. They are privately owned and not open to the public. The photo was taken on one of the few public paths.
images.alt: The picture shows the Greek Orthodox Churches "Anastasi Church" and "Agios Spyridon Church". The Anastasi Church (right) was built in 1865 and is dedicated to the Resurrection of Jesus Christ. In front of it, the Agios Spyridon Church, built in 1867, with its accompanying blue bell tower.
